title: fagaropsis angolensis

The health benefits of Fagaropsis angolensis include its ability to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions due to its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as an antipyretic, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory agent, which contributes to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Fagaropsis angolensis include limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and provide a basis for its traditional use in folk medicine.
